title: EWCR runtime projection v1 — read-only live state served to the Designer
description: Freezes architecture-c9070637.md §'Shared versioned contracts' item 4 (runtime projection) as the two endpoints AEF serves TODAY: GET /api/instances (web/blueprints/designer_api.py, T-4831) and GET /api/overlay (web/blueprints/designer.py + tools/corpus_overlay.py, T-2629/T-2634). Derived from the code, not designed: every field below is one the code emits. A field marked "x-internal": true is diagnostic or raw AEF vocabulary; the Designer must not branch on it, and AEF may change it without bumping runtime_projection_version. Any other change (rename, removal, new required field, narrowed or widened enum) bumps runtime_projection_version and is announced to 832. Neither response carries runtime_projection_version on the wire today; the version lives in this file. Both endpoints are unauthenticated GETs. Select the shape for a response with x-responses (path + HTTP status -> $defs entry).

map_id.description: Designer map (template) id: the directory name under .context/designer/projects/. /api/instances accepts ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]*$; /api/overlay accepts ^[a-z0-9-]{1,64}$ (no underscore, max 64). The two guards differ in the code today; this pattern is their union.

epoch_seconds.description: Server time the response was built, integer Unix seconds (int(time.time())). Not a version or change marker: it differs on every call.

lifecycle_node.description: A state-carrier uid on the aef-task-lifecycle map. tl_archive is never produced by /api/instances (it reads .tasks/active/ only).

instance.description: One active task file placed (or not) on the map.

task.description: Task id from the frontmatter id: field (e.g. T-4831); when the file has no id: field, the first two dash-separated parts of the file name.

state.description: NODE: the task maps to `node` and that uid exists in the map's latest version. STALE: it maps to `node` but the map no longer carries that uid (or the map version is unreadable, in which case every mapped task is STALE). NO-POSITION: the status/horizon pair has no node; `node` is null.

node.description: The lifecycle uid the task sits on, from the status+horizon table in designer_api._LIFECYCLE_NODES (captured+now/next -> tl_create, captured+later -> tl_parked, started-work -> tl_work, issues -> tl_heal, work-completed in active/ -> tl_human_review). Missing horizon counts as now. null exactly when state is NO-POSITION.

status.description: Raw frontmatter status: value, quotes stripped; empty string when absent. Not validated: any string the file holds is passed through. Render `node`/`state`, not this.

owner.description: Raw frontmatter owner: value, quotes stripped; empty string when absent. In practice "agent" or "human"; not enumerated by the code.

instance_refusal.description: An active task file that was examined but could not be placed. Reported, never silently dropped.

task.description: The task FILE name (e.g. T-9-bad.md), not a task id: the file could not be parsed for one.

reason.description: Free-text cause (today "no frontmatter" or "unreadable: <OSError>"). Display only.

instances_response.description: GET /api/instances?template=<map_id>, HTTP 200. Only aef-task-lifecycle has instances; any other known map returns NO-INSTANCES with examined 0 and empty lists.

template.description: Echo of the template query parameter.

state.description: INSTANCES when `instances` is non-empty, else NO-INSTANCES. Refusals do not count: a corpus whose every file was refused is NO-INSTANCES with refusals present.

examined.description: Number of .tasks/active/T-*.md files read (= len(instances) + len(refusals)). Diagnostic.

instances.description: Placed tasks, in file-name order of .tasks/active/.

overlay_node.description: One badge on one map node: a count of the tasks in that node's bucket. Only non-empty buckets whose uid exists in the map's latest version are emitted.

uid.description: Map node uid (aef:uid). aef-task-lifecycle: tl_create, tl_parked, tl_work, tl_heal, tl_human_review, tl_archive. aef-inception-flow: if_file, if_inception, if_gw_outcome, if_done_go, if_done_closed. Not enumerated here: the set is per-map and comes from tools/corpus_overlay.py PROFILES.

badge.description: Task count in the bucket, as a decimal string (never 0: empty buckets are omitted). Clamped at 48 chars.

severity.description: From the oldest task's last_update age in the bucket: info, warn >7 days, alert >30 days. Terminal buckets (tl_archive, if_done_*) are always info; the operator queue (if_gw_outcome) is warn, alert when its oldest waiter is >7 days. Thresholds are v0 defaults and may move without a version bump; the enum may not.

text.description: Human-readable tooltip, e.g. "3 task(s), 1 stuck >7d (oldest 12d) — focus: T-42". Display only; its wording is not a contract. Clamped at 200 chars.

overlay_response.description: GET /api/overlay?id=<map_id>, HTTP 200: the wire-canonical aef:annotate payload, forwarded verbatim to the Designer by the /designer/overlay wrapper on every aef:ready. A known map with no projection profile, or an unreadable latest version, returns an empty `nodes` list, not an error.

type.description: Message type for the Designer's postMessage intake.

map.description: Echo of the id query parameter. The intake ignores it.

nodes.description: Badges, at most one per uid. Order is not significant.

error_response.description: Error body for both endpoints. /api/instances: 400 "bad template id" (missing or malformed template parameter), 404 "unknown template" (no meta.json for it). /api/overlay: 404 "not found" for a malformed id AND for an unknown map (it has no 400). Branch on the HTTP status, not the text.

ok.description: Always false on an error body.

error.description: Short reason. Display only; wording may change.
